subject.title: fix: recover stuck Control UI chat runs

question: Should maintainers port and prove this watchdog on the current split Control UI chat path, waive the real-behavior proof gate, or pause the replacement branch while keeping the canonical issue open?
rationale: Automation cannot safely settle the remaining choice because this head is conflicting, the live code moved to new chat modules, and proof needs either real browser/gateway evidence or an explicit maintainer waiver.

options.title: Port and prove current-main watchdog
options.body: Reimplement the recovery in `ui/src/pages/chat/*`, refresh the branch to a clean merge result, and attach redacted proof showing stale-run recovery, history reload, and queued follow-up flush.

options.title: Waive proof explicitly
options.body: A maintainer can accept the timer-driven session/message-delivery risk with an explicit proof override after reviewing the source and tests.

options.title: Pause this replacement
options.body: Close or pause this stale branch if maintainers prefer a fresh fix path while keeping https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/42213 open.

recommendation.title: Port and prove current-main watchdog
recommendation.body: Reimplement the recovery in `ui/src/pages/chat/*`, refresh the branch to a clean merge result, and attach redacted proof showing stale-run recovery, history reload, and queued follow-up flush.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest combined history signal across current chat modules and adjacent gateway wait behavior, making him the best available owner for the port/proof decision.
